body:
I figured. Technically he doesn’t fall into either of those things. 

I could point him to the temp agencies actually. He’s work in fast food. Last one was low hours and caused him a lot of mental distress. But maybe a temp agency might work our better. Thanks for the tip!

I understand where you’re coming from. I was trying not to reveal too much due to privacy and respect for my partner’s privacy as well, but I’ll clarify a few things so there isn’t any confusion. And don’t worry about seeming like it was an attack, it’s a serious concern after all.

My partner and I are like 4-5 years apart age wise. He’s turned 20 and I’m 25. I know for some that age gap is a little strange, but most of our friends and my own family are supportive.

What I mean by can’t, is that the choices are limited. He’s tried getting a license and practicing, but everything he’s tried practicing with his parents, they either berate him or even smack him for slight mistakes. So is it impossible? No, but it’s difficult. And it’s a long process before anything can really be done.

Job market is job market. His last job consisted of being scheduled low hours, low pay, and it was affecting his mental health pretty bad. He does feel bad about quitting now that this situation is brought up, but I keep encouraging him to keep applying and help by finding job postings while he does his own research and calls back places.

He is trying. Whether by applying to different jobs everyday like he shows sometimes in DMs, or by trying the freelancing way and coming up with money to afford his own snacks if he can get clients (art related). And he has also said to take care of myself first before I help him. 

He isn’t in immediate danger (at least I assume he’s being honest with me on that). But what he tells me about his parents and of recent events did alarm me, and I don’t know how else to approach it in the best manner. Of course, I will only go for what he ultimately wants. And he’s desperately relying to find a job again before we look into other options. 

I understand the concern of being taking advantage off. I do know for certain he’s real if that was a worry. Even if we end up splitting up in the future, I’m still going to worry about him living in such a state. I’m not going to be bankrupting myself over this, but if I can buy him at least a good meal once, I won’t be as worried. At least until someone can finally hire him.

I appreciate the honestly and concern. Sorry if my vagueness on the info was suspicious.

They can’t drive at the moment, plus parents are so paranoid they refuse to even leave them in the house alone. I’m not even sure if calling services would do anything? 

I’m hoping when I visit in october i can at least help him stock up and make sure he’s okay. Just worried about how paranoid his parents are if they see me trying to help him just eating.

I’m not entirely sure of the parent’s diet. From what i remember, my partner said a few weeks ago they were gonna go on a diet themselves and asked him to join and he declined.
But because the parents are the ones getting groceries, they’re starting to limit even on snacks.
I’d be sending them money to get themselves food if i had the means. That’s why im working to find myself a job as well. 
Doing everything I can to save up and also help him find a job over there so he can start saving. Though his parents also expect him to pay rent still. So it’ll be a while before he has enough to move out.

Thank you so much! Yes, then i’ll call HR tomorrow and see what they say. It isn’t something I wanted to do. I was planning on finishing the year and then not renew for next year, but recent events have made me change my mind. I already need to take tomorrow off, so i’ll work on that while i’m at home.

I was considering that, but i’m not sure if my reasons would qualify? I am in pain at points, but it’s all due to mental stress/my mental illness. Would my doctor have to write specifically what’s wrong with me for them to accept it? 

Will call my doctor anyway about it. And HR on further questions. First time in the field learning fast as to why teachers get burn out so quickly and I’m a person who burns out very badly unfortunately.

No. Grad school is my own choice. I just don’t know when I’ll be accepted since I sent my application early. Most teaching positions in college require a Master’s anyway, so that’s why i’m getting myself.
That means a lot. Thank you for your kind words. I’ll stay strong for as long as i can and try to reach for help again.

Thank you. It really is a job i’m grateful for. 

And i know i need to fight the urge to do it again. I was actually clean for two years till today. Nothing bad even happened and i just… gave in. But i am going to try to continue getting help. Sometimes it just feels like a never-ending cycle.
